**Agent review** of the whole pull request, at `e5defa7`: all 67 files reviewed.

5 finding(s), 1 to fix; 5 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

**Batch 1 of 5.** I found no correctness or security bugs in this part. IPC inputs are validated in main (`isCaptureMode`, `parsePhaseReport`). The shade window uses the existing preload, and the countdown and Esc lifecycle in the hub is consistent. I left two notes: `recent-recordings.tsx` has no test, and the countdown value in a phase report isn't range-checked.

**Batch 2 of 5.** I found one correctness bug in this part. The aspect-ratio lock in frame-box.tsx is not gated on the record intent, so it stays active in screenshot mode after switching with P. The other files in this part had nothing worth flagging.

**Batch 3 of 5.** I reviewed the 10 files in this part and found no correctness or security bugs. I left one minor note: `SelectionToolbar` draws a divider even when the intent switch is absent. I did not run the tests. I checked the other files only by reading the diff, and I looked at one caller outside this part, capture-overlay.tsx, to confirm `onIntent` is always set there.

**Batch 4 of 5.** Reviewed the tests and stylesheets in part 4 from the diff alone and found no correctness, security or rules problems. I did not open the implementation files, so test-versus-code agreement is unchecked; the numbers the tests assert are internally consistent.

**Batch 5 of 5.** The CSS, docs and messages in this part look consistent: en.json and es.json have matching keys, the CSS variables the overlay uses exist, and the removed `useSelection`, `hintFrameRecord` and `{recordKey}` strings have no remaining callers. One note: several new `record.*` i18n keys look unused in the renderer, so they may be dead translations.
